features.name: Local Ghost Mode
features.description: 100% offline-first operation using local MongoDB instance (mongodb://localhost:27017) and local Ollama inference models on localhost:11434.

features.name: Zero-Persistence Memory Image Pipeline
features.description: Converts uploaded images directly to Base64 in volatile memory. Sends payload to vision models (LLaVA-7B / Llama 3.2 Vision) and immediately discards the binary payload without writing to disk or database.

features.name: Dual Database Ecosystem
features.description: Real-time automatic failover and manual switching between MongoDB Atlas (Global Cloud) and Local Ghost MongoDB.

features.name: Category-Wise Model Ranking Engine
features.description: Tracks and ranks model performance in real time across 5 distinct categories: Fast, Vision, Coding, Deep Reasoning, and Local Ollama.

features.name: Interactive Holo-Checklist Widget
features.description: Auto-detects and renders JSON checklist and report structures with interactive checkable items, star ratings, editable overview forms, data tracking matrices, and multi-format exports (JSON, MD, CSV, SVG).

features.name: Native Recharts Integration
features.description: Renders interactive Bar, Line, Area, and Scatter charts from JSON code blocks (```recharts).

features.name: Live Mermaid.js Flowchart Engine
features.description: Parses ```mermaid syntax into interactive vector flowcharts with clickable nodes.

features.name: Real-Time AI Topic Titling
features.description: Generates concise 3-5 word chat titles asynchronously on the first message and streams title updates to the sidebar in real time without page reloads.

features.name: PWA Mobile App Viewport Lock
features.description: Standalone mobile PWA installation support with viewport height locking (100dvh), safe-area insets padding, and elastic scroll prevention.

features.name: Immutable Model Source Tagging
features.description: Locks the exact model name (e.g. ORBITAL • QWEN 2.5 CODER 7B) on assistant messages permanently upon generation.
